authoring.method: AI-assisted synthetic source and known-source labels
authoring.disclosure: This corpus contains four wholly synthetic English software resumes authored with AI assistance in a separate authoring task. Labels come from the newly authored source text. No parser implementation, earlier locked source or labels, or recognition output informed authoring. Independent human annotation and adjudication have not been performed. This is a local engineering evaluation, not representative release validation.

scope: Local synthetic engineering evidence only; representative release validity and human agreement are not established.
freezeRule: Do not edit source or labels after evaluation. Do not tune against this locked corpus. Retain prior failed receipts and unchanged segment thresholds.
